free_tier.stated: Retail per-hour GPU rental with no minimum term, quoted from the front-page price table: RTX 2080Ti 11GB CNY 0.88/hour, RTX A4000 16GB CNY 0.92/hour, RTX 3080Ti 12GB CNY 0.98/hour, RTX 3090 24GB CNY 1.32/hour, V100 32GB and RTX 4090 24GB CNY 1.88/hour, RTX 5090 32GB CNY 2.78/hour, A800-80GB CNY 5.59/hour, PRO 6000 96GB CNY 6.98/hour, H800-80GB CNY 9.98/hour. Every row carries a member discount of 5 percent (会员95折), and students reach the member rate through educational-email verification.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: The per-second meter composes with object storage for checkpoints: rent a 4090 for the training step, stop it, and keep the dataset on the 20 GiB free netdisk, so idle time costs nothing between runs.
limits_note: Nothing throttles: billing is per second from container start to container stop with a CNY 0.01 minimum, so the constraint is money. A 24 GB RTX 4090 at CNY 1.88 an hour exhausts a CNY 100 deposit in about 53 hours, and the account stops when the balance reaches zero.
